body.statement: If every block of \(C\) is a singleton, then \(\mathcal N_j(C)=\varnothing\) for all \(j\in V\), and \(\mathcal R(C)\) is exactly the ordinary Markov-equivalence class of \(G\). If every nonempty block of \(C\) is nonsingleton, then \(\mathcal R(C)=\{C\}\). The first reduction equals the Chickering1995 covered-reversal component, and the second recovers the BPEC structural-identifiability conclusion of BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 on the proper blocked subclass.
body.justification: The endpoint reductions verify that the new component interpolates exactly between ordinary observational ambiguity and proper-blocked uniqueness.
body.gap: Chickering1995 and BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 establish the two endpoints separately but do not characterize the singleton-permitting interpolation.
body.consumer: The reductions provide exact regression tests for implementations and clarify when coefficient communities do or do not orient an arrow.
